title.zh: 从 MBIA 到护城河：比尔·阿克曼投资方法的演变
title.en: Evolving Investment Playbook, From MBIA to Moats

lead.zh: 本综述探讨比尔·阿克曼如何从早期房地产金融起步，历经戈谭合伙人的创立，最终形成以护城河和耐久性为核心的投资哲学。其思想轨迹深受格雷厄姆与多德价值投资原则的影响，强调在剧烈市场波动中坚持理性分析的重要性。
lead.en: This review explores how Bill Ackman evolved from early real estate finance to founding Gotham Partners, ultimately forming an investment philosophy centered on moats and durability. His intellectual trajectory was deeply influenced by the principles of value investing pioneered by Graham and Dodd, emphasizing rational analysis amidst volatile markets.

heading.zh: 价值投资的基石：格雷厄姆与多德的原则
heading.en: Foundations of Value Investing: Principles of Graham and Dodd

paragraphs.zh: 价值投资不仅是策略，更是一种思考金融的根本方式。该理念于 20 世纪 20 年代在哥伦比亚商学院由本杰明·格雷厄姆和大卫·多德创立，其著作《证券分析》为投资决策提供了首个理性基础。尽管经济环境剧变，这一方法在 20 世纪下半叶证明了其有效性及优于现代投资理论的地位。
paragraphs.en: Value investing is more than an investment strategy—it's a fundamental way of thinking about finance. Developed in the 1920s at Columbia Business School by Benjamin Graham and David Dodd, their classic text Security Analysis provided the first rational basis for investment decisions. Despite vast economic changes, this approach proved its validity and preeminence over modern investment theory during the second half of the twentieth century.

heading.zh: 关键转折点：MBIA 做空与 Valeant 的教训
heading.en: Pivotal Moments: The MBIA Short and Valeant Lessons

paragraphs.zh: 阿克曼的投资生涯包含塑造其思维的争议性时刻，包括对 MBIA 的早期做空操作以及 Valeant 事件带来的痛苦教训。这些经历促使他重新审视风险、激进主义及集中投资的方法，并更加重视企业的持久性和护城河的重要性。
paragraphs.en: Ackman's journey included controversial moments that shaped his thinking, such as his early short of MBIA and the painful lessons from the Valeant episode. These experiences prompted him to reevaluate approaches to risk, activism, and concentrated investing, placing greater emphasis on corporate durability and moats.

heading.zh: 当前使命：推广经典原则与教育对话
heading.en: Current Mission: Promoting Classic Principles and Academic Dialogue

paragraphs.zh: 当前任务在于推广格雷厄姆与多德的原初投资原则，并通过世界级教育、研究及从业者与学者的对话提升投资水平。播客将呈现全球顶尖投资者的观点，探讨他们如何发展投资流程以及该领域随时间的演变。
paragraphs.en: The current mission is to promote the study and practice of Graham & Dodd's original investing principles and improve investing through world-class education, research, and practitioner-academic dialogue. The podcast features views from some of the world's greatest investors on how they developed their processes and how the field changes over time.
